title: Refactoring UI - Bad About
text: Hey guys, welcome back to another edition of Refactoring UI. Today we're going to be taking a look at a submission from Christopher Harris. It's a side project he's been working on called Fat About and it allows you to quickly share and discover the drawbacks about something to help you make a more informed decision, be it a product, service, or another general topic. It's pretty cool. And right now they're looking for early contributors to help kickstart the community. So check it out, create an account, and make a post if you think you have something worth sharing. And today we're going to be looking at the topic page that lists all of the posts.
zh: 大家好，欢迎回到新一期的《重构 UI》。今天我们要来看看 Christopher Harris 提交的一个项目。这是他一直在做的一个副业项目，名为 Fat About。它可以帮助你快速分享和发现某个事物的缺点，从而帮助你做出更明智的决定——无论是产品、服务还是其他一般性话题。这个项目真的很酷。目前他们正在寻找早期的贡献者来帮助启动社区。所以，快去看看吧，创建一个账户，如果你认为有值得分享的内容，就发布一篇帖子。今天我们要看的是列出所有帖子的主题页面。
